This browser bundle contains YAML 2.8.3 (ISC) and js-sha256 0.11.1 (MIT).
The accompanying license files are included in this directory.

The bundle supplies libraries absent from older SillyTavern releases. It was
built from the browser entry of yaml and js-sha256/src/sha256.js using Webpack 5,
production mode, ES module output, and process: undefined.
It has no network or Node.js dependencies.
